autocomplete.helper: Show GitHub-Copilot-style inline command suggestions as you type. Tab or → accepts; Esc dismisses. Accepting only fills the line — it never runs the command.
autocomplete.label: AI command autocomplete

persistHistory.helper: Store executed commands locally so suggestions survive restarts. Lines that look like secrets are never stored.
persistHistory.label: Persist command history

popup.helper: Ctrl+Space or a second Tab opens a keyboard-navigable list of candidates at the cursor.
popup.label: Candidate popup

autocomplete.privacy: When AI is enabled, the current command, working directory, and recent history are sent to your configured model to generate a suggestion. Context that looks like a secret (API keys, tokens, credentials) is detected and skipped. Plugin-contributed providers are unaffected by this setting.

bell.helper: How the terminal reacts to the BEL character (\a) programs emit — e.g. shell completion failures or long-running commands ringing on finish.
bell.label: Terminal bell

boldBrightColors.helper: Render bold ANSI text with the bright variant of its color.
boldBrightColors.label: Bright colors for bold text

commandActions.helper: Make the per-command gutter dots interactive: click one to rerun the command or copy the command and its output, with the exit code and duration.
commandActions.label: Command actions

confirmOnClose.helper: Ask before closing a tab whose shell is still running a command, so an accidental close doesn't kill an in-flight run. Idle tabs always close immediately.
confirmOnClose.label: Confirm before closing a running terminal

copyOnSelect.helper: When on, every text selection in a terminal is auto-copied to the clipboard. Off by default so accidental selection doesn't overwrite your clipboard.
copyOnSelect.label: Copy on selection

cursor.label: Cursor style
cursor.widthHelper: Cursor width applies to bar-style cursors and is clamped to 1–10 pixels.

customGlyphs.helper: Use xterm's built-in box-drawing and block glyphs for crisp terminal UI.
customGlyphs.label: Custom terminal glyphs

exposeDockToAgents.helper: Lets the chat agent drive your visible terminal tabs via the synthetic terminal_dock_* MCP tools. The agent shares the same PTY you see — one shell, one cwd, one history. Each tab requires per-session consent. Off by default.
exposeDockToAgents.label: Expose dock to agents

fontFamily.label: Font family
fontFamily.nerdFontHelper: oh-my-posh and powerlevel10k prompts need a Nerd Font for their icons. The app ships MesloLGS NF, so they render out of the box — click below to select it, or type your own installed Nerd Font.
fontFamily.pickerHint: Pick from monospace fonts detected on this device.

fontPreview.label: Preview
fontPreview.missing: "{family}" isn't installed on this machine — the terminal is falling back to the next font in the stack.

forceUtf8.helper: Pin PowerShell / cmd console output to UTF-8 so powerline glyphs and CJK text render correctly on non-UTF-8 system codepages (e.g. GBK on Chinese Windows). Leave on unless you depend on the legacy codepage.
forceUtf8.label: Force UTF-8 output

heading: Integrated terminal

diagnostics.helper: Collect bounded transport lifecycle, version, overflow, and error-code diagnostics. Terminal input, output, credentials, and full identifiers are never collected.
diagnostics.label: Share terminal diagnostics

maxRemoteSessions.helper: Maximum sessions each paired device may create remotely.
maxRemoteSessions.label: Remote sessions per device

maxSessions.helper: Maximum number of live local and SSH sessions owned by this host.
maxSessions.label: Live sessions

host.operationFailed: The terminal host setting could not be saved.

remoteAccess.helper: Allow independently authorized paired devices to attach over LAN or WAN.
remoteAccess.label: Remote terminal access

replayPerSession.helper: Maximum in-memory replay retained for each live session, in MiB.
replayPerSession.label: Replay per session (MiB)

replayTotal.helper: Maximum in-memory replay retained across all live sessions, in MiB.
replayTotal.label: Total replay memory (MiB)

startAtLogin.helper: Start the lightweight terminal host when you sign in so remote sessions are reachable before Cognia opens.
startAtLogin.label: Start host at login

host.unreachable: These settings belong to the terminal host. This shell is not connected to one, so nothing here can be applied — pair with a host, or configure it where it runs.

ligatures.helper: Render programming-font ligatures (Cascadia Code, JetBrains Mono, Fira Code). Off by default; toggling reloads the terminal.
ligatures.label: Font ligatures

lineHeight.helper: Line height multiplies the font size; letter spacing adds horizontal pixels between glyphs. Both re-fit the terminal.
lineHeight.label: Line height

minContrast.helper: Force a minimum contrast ratio between text and background for legibility. Off keeps the raw ANSI colors; AA / AAA meet WCAG; Maximum forces black/white.
minContrast.label: Minimum contrast

profiles.helper: Named shell presets (shell + working directory) the new-tab menu can launch. Set one as default for the plain "+ New" button.
profiles.syncError: Could not synchronize terminal profiles with the terminal host
profiles.title: Launch profiles

projectOverride.emptyProjects: No projects yet — overrides become available once you create one.
projectOverride.helper: Pick a project to override its shell or cwd. Empty fields fall back to the global default.
projectOverride.title: Per-project override

quickFixes.helper: Show a lightbulb on a failed command offering a fix — git push --set-upstream, “did you mean”, create-PR link, freeing a busy port, pwsh command-not-found, and more.
quickFixes.label: Quick fixes

renderer.helper: Auto picks GPU-accelerated WebGL, falling back to Canvas then DOM. Switch to Canvas or DOM if the terminal renders blank or garbled.
renderer.label: Renderer

rescaleOverlappingGlyphs.helper: Rescale wide glyphs that would otherwise overlap adjacent terminal cells.
rescaleOverlappingGlyphs.label: Rescale overlapping glyphs

runInDockTimeout.helper: How long the chat 'Run in dock' affordance and the agent's terminal_dock_write tool wait for a command_end OSC 633 event before timing out. Per-call overrides win; this is the floor. Range 5–600, default 60.
runInDockTimeout.label: Run-in-dock timeout (seconds)

sandboxed.helper: Launch dock terminals inside the OS sandbox (bwrap / sandbox-exec): writes are confined to the session working directory, your home stays read-only, network stays on. Experimental; off by default and not yet available on Windows.
sandboxed.label: Sandboxed terminal

scrollSensitivity.helper: Lines scrolled per mouse-wheel notch. Alt-scroll moves 5× faster.
scrollSensitivity.label: Scroll speed (lines)

scrollback.helper: Number of lines kept in xterm's history buffer. Range 1000–100000.
scrollback.label: Scrollback lines

shell.helper: Auto-detect picks pwsh on Windows, zsh on macOS, bash on Linux. Per-project overrides win when set. cmd.exe spawns without OSC 633 integration.
shell.label: Default shell

shellIntegration.helper: Injects OSC 633 prompt markers (bash / zsh / pwsh) so the dock can show command status and cwd badges. Disable for shells that mis-parse the sequences.
shellIntegration.label: Enable shell integration

smoothScrolling.helper: Animate wheel and touchpad scrolling instead of jumping between terminal rows.
smoothScrolling.label: Smooth scrolling

adjustments.bindNarrowedToLoopback: A forward binding a wider address will be narrowed to 127.0.0.1.
adjustments.extraAliasesDropped: Only the first alias on the Host line becomes a profile.
adjustments.remoteForwardDisabled: Remote forwards are imported switched off; turn one on when you want it.

configImport.noHosts: The file has no host entries this app can import.

notices.missingHostName: “{subject}” has no HostName, so it will connect to that name directly.
notices.proxyCommand: ProxyCommand on “{subject}” has no equivalent here; set a jump host instead.
notices.title: Not imported
notices.wildcardHost: Host pattern “{subject}” cannot become a single profile.

configImport.title: Import SSH hosts
configImport.unreadableHere: This shell cannot read a local ~/.ssh/config. The file lives on the machine running the desktop app; import it there and the hosts will be here too.

fields.agentNotice: Signing is delegated to your running ssh-agent. No password, passphrase, or key path is stored for this host.
fields.name: Display name

forwarding.desktopApplies: Configured here, applied by the desktop. A jump chain and a forwarding rule are stripped from the profile the Host receives, so on a paired device these fields are recorded and never take effect: a phone naming a profile gets a shell, never a listening port.

errors.duplicate_local_port: Another rule already listens on this local port.
errors.duplicate_remote_port: Another rule already uses this port on the server.

jumpHost.helper: Each hop authenticates on its own account and its host key is trusted separately, so connect to a bastion once by itself before using it here.
jumpHost.label: Connect through

local.helper: Listens on 127.0.0.1 on this machine and hands each connection to the server, which dials the destination. Reachable only from this machine.
local.label: Local forwards (-L)
local.remoteHost: Destination host, as the server sees it

remote.label: Remote forwards (-R)
remote.warning: The server listens on its own 127.0.0.1 and sends each connection back here. Anyone with access to that machine can then reach the local port you name. Off until you turn it on, and never included when a profile is shared with your phone or another device.

ssh.helper: Credentials are stored in the system keyring. The first connection trusts and saves the host fingerprint; changed fingerprints are rejected.

hostKeyChanged.body: {host}:{port} presented a different key than the one saved on the first connection. This happens when a server is rebuilt or reinstalled — but it is also what a machine-in-the-middle looks like. The connection was refused.
hostKeyChanged.guidance: Only continue if you can confirm the new fingerprint out of band — from the server console, your provider's dashboard, or whoever rebuilt it.
hostKeyChanged.title: The host key for this server has changed
hostKeyChanged.trust: Forget the old key and trust this one
hostKeyChanged.desktopOnly: Forgetting the old key writes to this machine's known_hosts, which only the desktop app can do. Both fingerprints are above: verify the new one out of band, then re-trust it from the desktop.

ssh.notSynced: Saved on this device only. The desktop app is what pushes these to the Host, so a host added here will not exist there until the desktop syncs it, and Connect will report that the profile is not on the Host. Jump hosts and port forwards never sync at all, by design.
ssh.title: SSH hosts

toasts.hostKeyForgotten: Old host key forgotten. Connect again to trust the new one.
toasts.importJumpsDropped: These hosts will connect directly because their jump host was not imported: {names}
toasts.imported: Imported {created} new and replaced {replaced} SSH host(s)
toasts.learned: Connected and saved the host fingerprint
toasts.removeFailed: Could not remove the SSH host
toasts.syncFailed: Could not synchronize SSH profiles with the terminal host
toasts.verified: Connected with a verified host fingerprint
toasts.connectedViaHost: Connected through the host, which verified the server key with the copy it keeps.

stickyScroll.helper: Pin the current command's prompt line at the top of the viewport while you scroll through its output.
stickyScroll.label: Sticky scroll

subheading: Default shell, font and scrollback for the bottom dock. Per-project overrides take precedence over these defaults.

askPolicy.helper: Applies to commands the safety classifier is unsure about (verdict "ask").
askPolicy.label: When a command needs confirmation

unattended.helper: Let workflow terminal steps run shell commands headlessly — no visible terminal tab, no consent prompt. Every command is screened by the safety classifier first; clearly dangerous commands are always blocked.
unattended.label: Allow unattended execution
